about: Safety rating of every SWELL BOM line (pm/BOM.csv at the zip's pinned commit): from the maker's own datasheet where the BOM names a part (kind maker-rating, with the document read and an exact quote), or the rating the part must carry where it names none (required), or none. Sourced 2026-10-10 by an AI worker (runner life 6, audit A-10); each document's SHA-256 is recorded. Feeds the zip's pm/BOM.csv column and docs/BOM.md section; the SWELL page's ratings table must say the same. Updated 2026-10-10 (runner life 8, audit A-11): C-05 (water beads) left the design; H-27 and H-28 added; H-03, H-18, H-19 and H-23 now say how the gears and rollers are guarded and powered. Updated 2026-10-11 (runner life 12, N-20, D-75): T-01 (3D printer) and T-02 (soldering iron) left the build; H-28 is now an enclosed DIN-rail converter (MEAN WELL DDR-60G-12, its datasheet read that day); H-13 names the driver version with leads fitted; H-19 and the new H-29, H-30 and H-31 say how the build avoids hot tools. Reworded the same day after round 1 of the AI review: H-19, H-29 and H-30.

lines.rating_en: Not chosen: a two-pole switch, its contacts rated above the LED supply and the relay coil it drives; one pole cuts the LED, the other opens a relay that stops every motor, and an open lid or a broken wire does both.

lines.rating_en: Not chosen: a certified plug-in adapter (IEC 62368-1), 24 V DC or less out; a fuse on every rail; every part rated for its rail's voltage and current; the 5 V converter an enclosed DIN-rail module like H-28, and it, the fuses and the relay board sit in the closed electronics compartment (H-30); every join the builder makes a screw or lever terminal (H-31) or a ready-made plug-in lead; the 24 V fuse a time-delay type that rides through the converters' inrush. The 12 V pumps (H-23) get their rail from H-28.
lines.rating_zh: 尚未选定：认证的插墙式适配器（IEC 62368-1），输出不超过 24 V 直流；每一路都有保险丝；每个零件的额定值都要匹配所在电源轨的电压和电流；5 V 降压用像 H-28 那样带外壳的导轨式模块，它和保险丝、继电器板都装在封闭的电子仓（H-30）里；造的人接的每个接头，都用螺丝端子、杠杆式接线端子（H-31）或现成的插头线；24 V 保险丝用慢断型，能扛住变换器开机时的冲击电流。12 V 的水泵（H-23）由 H-28 供电。

lines.rating_en: MEAN WELL DDR-60G-12: 9–36 V DC in, 12 V DC out at up to 5 A (60 W); short-circuit, overload, over-voltage, input reverse-polarity and under-voltage protection; approved to IEC 62368-1 and UL 62368-1; an enclosed converter with screw terminals, cooled by free air (full load up to 60 °C ambient above 18 V input). It sits on a DIN rail inside the closed electronics compartment (H-30), out of reach, and its output to the pumps passes through the lid relay and the leak latch.
lines.rating_zh: MEAN WELL DDR-60G-12：输入 9–36 V 直流，输出 12 V 直流、最大 5 A（60 W）；带短路、过载、过压、输入反接和欠压保护；通过 IEC 62368-1 和 UL 62368-1 认证；带外壳、用螺丝端子接线的变换器，靠自然对流散热（输入高于 18 V 时，环境温度 60 °C 以下可以满载）。它装在封闭电子仓（H-30）里的导轨上，手够不到；给水泵的输出经过开盖继电器和漏液锁存。
lines.part_en: 12 V rail for the pumps: MEAN WELL DDR-60G-12 enclosed DC-DC converter
lines.part_zh: 水泵的 12 V 电源：MEAN WELL DDR-60G-12 带外壳的 DC-DC 变换器

lines.rating_en: Lab only: coverslips, glass-bottom dishes and punches are sharp (adults); gloves are the chemical-resistant kind each reagent's SDS names.
lines.rating_zh: 仅限实验室：盖玻片、玻璃底培养皿和打孔器都锋利（只由成年人处理）；手套要用各试剂 SDS 指定的耐化学品类型。
lines.part_zh: 盖玻片、玻璃底培养皿、打孔器、手套

lines.rating_en: The host lab's own equipment, used as its makers intend: the 95 °C block can scald and burn; centrifuges stay lidded while spinning.
lines.rating_zh: 实验室自己的设备，按厂商的用途使用：95 °C 加热块会烫伤；离心机运转时盖子不打开。
lines.part_en: Host-lab equipment: pipettes, centrifuge, 95 °C block, incubator
lines.part_zh: 实验室设备：移液器、离心机、95 °C 加热块、培养箱

lines.rating_en: Optional spare glass objectives, never design inputs; no electrical, thermal or magnetic hazard.
lines.rating_zh: 可选的备用玻璃物镜，从不作为设计输入；没有电气、热或磁方面的危害。

lines.rating_en: Optional benchmark camera used as its maker intends; never a design input or part of the build.
lines.rating_zh: 可选的对照相机，按厂商用途使用；从不作为设计输入，也不是制作的一部分。
